from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib
import yaml
from tools.wlc import OT_BOOKS, OSIS_NS, word_text, load_book_tree
def consonants(s):
 return ''.join(c for c in s if '\u05d0' <= c <= '\u05ea')
out=[]
pins={}
for code,(_,slug,title,filename) in OT_BOOKS.items():
 path=Path('sources/ot/wlc')/filename
 pins[str(path)]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 root=load_book_tree(str(path))
 for v in root.findall('.//o:verse',OSIS_NS):
  words=[consonants(word_text(w)[0]) for w in list(v) if w.tag.endswith('}w')]
  pairs=[(i,words[i],words[i+1]) for i in range(len(words)-1) if words[i].endswith('עשתי') and words[i+1] in ('עשר','עשרה')]
  if not pairs: continue
  pins[str(path)]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  ident=v.attrib['osisID']; _,ch,num=ident.split('.')
  p=Path(f'translation/ot/{slug}/{int(ch):03}/{int(num):03}.yaml')
  r=yaml.safe_load(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else None
  raw=r['source']['text'] if r else ''
  normalized=[consonants(w) for w in raw.split()]
  source_has=any(normalized[i].endswith('עשתי') and normalized[i+1] in ('עשר','עשרה') for i in range(len(normalized)-1))
  english=r['translation']['text'] if r else None
  out.append({'wlc_reference':ident,'word_occurrences':len(pairs),'candidate_path':str(p),'actual_reference':r.get('reference') if r else None,'source_pair_present':source_has,'english':english,'contains_eleven_or_eleventh':bool(english and re.search(r'\beleven(?:th)?\b',english,re.I)),'yaml_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.exists() else None})
print(json.dumps({'scope':'39 pinned-local WLC books; compound-specific source/English alignment screen, not a manuscript collation or corpus-wide fidelity score','verses':len(out),'word_occurrences':sum(r['word_occurrences'] for r in out),'records':out,'xml_pins':pins},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
